verdict.rationale: Aleph documents mapping agents that users configure with natural-language prompts and that then monitor source data 24/7 in the background, and it markets reporting automation and putting reporting on autopilot. The background autonomy shown is narrow: it is limited to mapping suggestions, and changes still need human approval through Slack or Teams alerts. Missing for 10: general user-defined automations or workflows beyond mappings, documented scheduling or recurring-trigger configuration, details of how reporting automation runs unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
